{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect basic info
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nCount of customer_age == -1:')
print(df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())

# Check revenue column
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):')
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print('\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):')
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check status column
print('\nStatus value counts:')
print(df['status'].value_counts())"}
